tools.name: search_tournaments
tools.description: Search the public tennis tournament calendar of Tennis Control (www.tenniscontrol.es): national federations of 50+ countries, Tennis Europe, ITF Juniors, ATF, COSAT, COTECC, and professional tours (ATP, Challenger, WTA, ITF). Filter by country, region, category, circuit, dates, text or open registra

tools.name: get_tournament
tools.description: Full public details of one tournament by its id (from search_tournaments): dates, venue, categories, entry and withdrawal deadlines, entry rule and official link.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Countries covered by the Tennis Control calendar, with code, name and number of upcoming tournaments.

tools.name: list_circuits
tools.description: Circuits (federations, international and professional tours) and age categories available, with number of upcoming tournaments.
